name: Greatwood Vale
summary: Greatwood Vale is a forested valley nestled in the eastern foothills of the Stonetalon Mountains, reached via the perilous Webwinder Path. Recently, the hostile Grimtotem tribe seized the vale, using it as a staging ground for bloody assaults on neighboring settlements.

sections.title: A Contested Valley
sections.body: Tucked away off the Webwinder Path, Greatwood Vale has become a violent frontier. The Grimtotem tribe, under the ruthless leadership of Grundig Darkcloud, has moved into the vale in force, cutting off safe passage and bringing terror to the surrounding foothills.

sections.title: The Scourge of Camp Aparaje
sections.body: The Grimtotem did not merely occupy Greatwood Vale; they used it to orchestrate the butchery of nearby Camp Aparaje. Sweeping out of the woods, Darkcloud's raiders slaughtered nearly every tauren inhabiting the encampment. Makaba Flathoof, one of the few survivors who managed to flee the carnage, now directs vengeful Horde warriors straight into the heart of Greatwood Vale to cut down the renegade Grimtotem and put an end to Grundig Darkcloud.

faq.q: Who controls Greatwood Vale right now?
faq.answer: The valley is occupied by the hostile Grimtotem tribe, led locally by Grundig Darkcloud. They hold the woods with warbands and spellcasters, menacing anyone attempting to travel the region.

The Grimtotem launched a surprise attack from Greatwood Vale upon Camp Aparaje, massacring most of its peaceful tauren residents. Makaba Flathoof survived the slaughter and now seeks vengeance against the raiders and their leader.

faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting the Grimtotem here?
faq.answer: The Grimtotem tribe has not formally joined the Horde, despite Magatha's presence in Thunder Bluff. Grundig Darkcloud's followers attacked fellow tauren at Camp Aparaje, prompting survivors to call on Horde adventurers for aid.

angles.text: The Grimtotem's treacherous slaughter of fellow tauren at Camp Aparaje makes the cleansing of Greatwood Vale a deeply personal, sorrowful duty for Thunder Bluff's loyal children.
Securing Greatwood Vale is essential to protect the fragile southern outpost of Malaka'jin from sudden flank attacks by rogue Grimtotem.
